-- Scenario 73f: the CLD sync stalls while SAP keeps publishing. Nothing errors.
-- Expected: every DT refresh still reports success, on stale data. Only G2 freshness
-- (V_L0_FRESHNESS) shows the problem. Fix: 74f_resume_sync.sql.
alter task {{DEMO_L0}}.SYNC.SYNC_L0 suspend;

insert into {{DEMO_L0}}.PUBLISHER.MAINT_NOTIFICATION
  (MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION, EQUIPMENT, NOTIFICATIONTYPE, PRIORITY, CREATEDON, DOWNTIMEHOURS, NOTIFICATIONTEXT)
select 'N-' || lpad(3000 + n, 6, '0'), 'E-' || (1001 + mod(n, 10)), 'M1', '2',
       dateadd(day, mod(n, 20), '2026-10-01'::date), (3 + mod(n * 11, 60) / 10)::number(10,2), 'Published during sync stall ' || n
from (select row_number() over (order by seq4()) as n from table(generator(rowcount => 40)));

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('73f', 'SCENARIO_RUN', null, 'CLD sync stalled (SYNC_L0 suspended) while SAP published 40 more notifications', 'PRESENTER');
